name: Sheep Island View
accommodation: Hostel rooms including ground-floor and family rooms
beachAccess: About 1.9 miles to White Park Bay
confirmedFeatures: Self-catering kitchen, laundry service, WiFi, TV and games room, group meals on request, collection service
overview: An independent hostel on Main Street in Ballintoy, with a bus stop at the door and pubs about 150 metres away. It has a self-catering kitchen, laundry service, games room and on-site parking, with family rooms on request. White Park Bay is just under two miles west, and Carrick-a-Rede and the Giant's Causeway are close by.
surfTripFit: A budget base with parking and a kitchen, a few minutes' drive from White Park Bay.
